Append a step to a run log

Source: R/logging.R
log_step.Rd

Append a step to a run log

Usage

log_step(log, message, data = NULL)

Arguments

log

A run-log object.

message

A short description of the step.

data

An optional named list of step details.

Value

The updated run-log object.
